description:
About the company
 Our client is a financial technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the design, build and production delivery of backend services for a payments platform. Work closely with senior leadership and product on architecture choices, and contribute across the full stack as priorities require.
 What you'll do
 - Build and run backend server applications and components from initial design through production.
 - Contribute to architecture decisions across APIs, backend services and infrastructure, and help set engineering standards.
 - Work directly with leadership, product and fellow engineers in whiteboarding sessions and technical discussions.
 - Improve real-time monitoring and alerting so the team can understand usage and iterate on the product.
 - Take on varied projects across the platform rather than staying within a single product area.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - About 2 years or more of backend or full stack engineering experience.
 - Background at a reputable, growing technology company, ideally an early-stage startup.
 - Track record of owning and building scalable backend systems end to end.
 - Experience in fintech or payments infrastructure.
 - Bachelor's degree in a technical field.
 - Production experience with containers and container orchestration.
 - Proficiency in Go or Node.js.
 - Experience with infrastructure as code and cloud infrastructure.
 - Clear communicator with strong technical convictions who is comfortable debating ideas in a fast-moving environment.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 180,000 to 230,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - New York, New York, United States
 - On-site, 4 days per week in office
 - Full-time
